GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well from the Inside . held rail 5th 4 Lengths @ 1100m. 2 Lengths 3rd to home Turn . Hard Ridden railing into Straight . Clear in Straight stuck on ok # railed/sound

jumped awkwardly . Beaten for early speed & raced @ rear Two Wide (10L from lead). Stayed @ rear Two Wide midrace & pushed to chase Four Wide @ 500m. Chasing 8W (6L from lead) on home turn. Pressured 8W @ 250m & ground to line in last 150m. # Fair from rear.

Jumped fairly. Rolled fwd & caught 3rd 3 Wide until worked to lead on rail by 1.5L early . Held lead on inside until joined in front @ 600m. Pushed to quicken @ 500m & pressired =lead Two Wide on home turn. Fought on in two-horse battle from 200m until faded late. # Led- tried hard
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Brushed with another runner passing the 75m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok took sit 3rd 2 Lengths 1000m over-racing 3rd 3 Lengths 600m Hard Ridden 4th Straightened Up 3rd Under Pressure weakened final 200m # pace/weak late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began very awkwardly, shifted out and made contact with another rnr.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well to lead half clear, held together turn, joint lead Straightening Up , took over 200m and drew clear # led/kept finding
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted ground on a number of occasions in the home straight, requiring its rider to stop riding and straighten.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped OK. Rolled fwd & shared lead on inside early . Stayed =lead on inside midrace & pushed along on rail @ 600m. Pressured on inside (1L clear) on home turn. Boxed on until weakened in last 150m. # On-pace/weakened.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Qst performance rider explained in his oppinion did not run out a strong 2000m, and was not aided in that endeavour when, after establishing the lead there was a contest for the position outside the leader which did not allow him to settle the pace in the early and middle stages. a post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok pressed on to lead 1 length clear, pushed along turn, Straightened Up half clear, narrow lead 100m, kept on strong drew clear late # led/kept finding
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Change of tactics: intention to be ridden further forward; led.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 Lengths , Settled 3rd last 3 Wide 10 Lengths 800m, started to move into the race widest from the 600m, sustained run in Straight and although winner dominant was not far off minor placing # sustained long run
Jumped Ok sat 2-3l off 4 Wide No Cover , under pressure turn and dropped out # 4 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout the event.
